name: claude-code
summary: Watches the settings, sandboxing and model-overview pages, not just the CLI overview. The adapter pins two things that go stale silently and that no gate can check offline: the sandbox block both baselines now ship (sandbox.enabled is opt-in and NO domains are pre-allowed, so the allowlist is load-bearing), and the tier->model-id map in apply-adapter-sync.sh that all 88 `model: opus|sonnet` agents are projected through. Those were pinned to claude-opus-4-8 / claude-sonnet-4-6 — still served, but a generation behind what the alias means.
